Author: joshua88wa
Name: Nearby Player List
Punchline: A clickable list of nearby targetable players.
Description: Shows a compact, clickable list of player characters you can actually target, so you can heal or raise people in The Hunt, Diadem, Eureka, Bozja and the Occult Crescent without fighting the mouse.
FeedbackMessage: Please report bugs and suggestions on the issue tracker at https://github.com/joshua88wa/FFXIV-Dalamud-NearbyPlayerList/issues so they can be tracked and replied to.
Changelog: The list no longer re-sorts while the mouse is over it, so a click lands on the player you aimed at rather than whoever was sorted into that slot. Only positions are pinned: HP bars and raise labels keep updating. A player who leaves holds an empty slot until you move off. On by default, in the Other tab, with a 200 ms hold after the pointer leaves.

Author: joshua88wa
Name: Plugin Menu
Punchline: A one click menu for your installed plugins.
Description: Adds a small floating button that opens a searchable, scrollable list of every installed and enabled plugin, each with its Open and Settings windows one click away. Plugins can be hidden from the list and brought back later.
FeedbackMessage: Please report bugs and suggestions on the issue tracker at https://github.com/joshua88wa/FFXIV-Dalamud-PluginMenu/issues so they can be tracked and replied to.

Author: joshua88wa
Name: Blue Mage Set Builder
Punchline: Builds the best Blue Mage spell set from the spells you have learned.
Description: Reads which Blue Mage spells you have learned and builds a 24-spell active set for the content you pick: solo and FATE leveling, dungeons, trials and raids, tanking or healing. Shows why each spell made the cut, lists the spells worth learning next and where to get them, and applies the set with one click when you are out of combat.
FeedbackMessage: Please report bugs and suggestions on the issue tracker at https://github.com/joshua88wa/FFXIV-Dalamud-BlueMageSetBuilder/issues so they can be tracked and replied to.
